notes: Voice notes actually get heard now. Two plumbing bugs were fixed: the transcription request called a malformed URL and the fallback speech model had an invalid name. If your model server keeps transcription host-local, the bot now retries over loopback automatically, and real failure reasons land in the log instead of vanishing.
notes_zh: 语音消息现在真的能被听懂了。修复两个底层问题：转写请求曾拼出格式错误的网址，本地兜底语音模型名称也无效。模型服务器将转写接口限制为本机访问时，bot 会自动改用回环地址重试；失败时真实原因会记入日志而不是消失。
